codified_protocols.protocol_name: The Josephis Protocol for Competency and Character Integrity

foundational_laws.name: The Proximity Constraint (5-Year Rule)
foundational_laws.description: No entity shall deem an individual incompetent if they have not had contact with them in over 5 years, unless a pool of peers and friends agrees on the underlying cause.
foundational_laws.strategic_goal: Enforce recency and consensus in evidence (High Statistical Variable).

foundational_laws.name: The Expertise Mandate & Integrity Guardrail
foundational_laws.description: No one shall spread hearsay or question a person's mental competency that results in defamation without first being a family member AND having a legal degree in Psychology or the like.
foundational_laws.strategic_goal: Protect character/reputation and mandate professional, objective inputs.

foundational_laws.name: The Consent Mandate (Biological Sovereignty)
foundational_laws.description: No technology created for monitoring an individual shall be used without their consent, especially biological monitoring without knowledge.
foundational_laws.strategic_goal: Establish the individual as the supreme access control authority over their bio-data stream.

enforcement_mechanism.mechanism_name: Decentralized Biometric Consent and Audit Protocol (DBCAP)

accountability_system.bond_requirement: Mandatory Security Bond (SB) staked by TPE in CC escrow.
